map.输入逻辑表达式，自动识别变量并生成完整真值表。支持与或非、异或、蕴含、等价等运算: Enter a logical expression; variables are auto-detected and a complete truth table is generated. Supports AND, OR, NOT, XOR, implication, equivalence, etc.
map.逻辑表达式（变量用字母，如 A、B、C）: Logical expression (use letters for variables, e.g. A, B, C)
map.数字电路设计中，列出输入组合对应的输出，验证与门、或门、异或等组合逻辑是否正确。: In digital circuit design, list the output for each input combination to verify whether the combinational logic of AND, OR, XOR etc. is correct.
map.布尔代数与离散数学里，用真值表证明等价律（如德摩根律）或化简表达式。: In Boolean algebra and discrete math, use truth tables to prove equivalence laws (e.g. De Morgan's laws) or simplify expressions.
map.形式逻辑与编程条件判断中，核对复杂布尔表达式（含 AND/OR/NOT 与括号）: In formal logic and programming conditionals, check the precedence and short-circuit behavior of complex Boolean expressions (including AND/OR/NOT and parentheses).
map.三个变量共 2³=8 种组合。按 A、B、C 顺序（高位到低位）遍历 000…1: Three variables give 2³=8 combinations. Traverse 000...111 in order A, B, C (high bit to low bit); the output sequence is 00001011 (true only when A=1 and (B=1 or C=0)).
map.比较 ¬(A∧B) 与 (¬A∨¬B) 两列，8 行结果完全一致即证等价。同理: Compare the two columns ¬(A∧B) and (¬A∨¬B); if all 8 rows match, equivalence is proven. Similarly ¬(A∨B)≡(¬A∧¬B). The truth table is the most direct way to verify logical identities.
map.变量多了真值表会不会爆炸？: Does the truth table explode when variables grow?
map.会。n 个变量有 2ⁿ 行，n=10 就 1024 行，n=20 超百万行，手工: Yes. n variables give 2ⁿ rows; n=10 is already 1024 rows, n=20 exceeds a million rows, impractical by hand. Then switch to algebraic simplification (Karnaugh map, Boolean algebra) or programmatic generation; the tool is generally display-friendly for n≤6 or so.
map.通常 NOT > AND > OR（与日常和多数语言一致），但括号优先于一切。建: Usually NOT > AND > OR (consistent with everyday and most languages), but parentheses take priority over everything. For complex expressions, add parentheses explicitly; the truth table tool evaluates by fixed precedence, so if the result differs from expectation, first check for missing parentheses.
map.逻辑真值表生成器是一款科学研究领域的在线工具。科学研究工具，采用标准科学公式，计: The logic truth table generator is an online tool in the scientific research field. A scientific research tool that uses standard scientific formulas for accurate calculation.
map.真值表列出命题在所有变量取值组合下的真假（1/0 或 T/F），用于验证逻辑等价: A truth table lists the true/false (1/0 or T/F) of a proposition under all combinations of variable values, used to verify logical equivalence, tautologies and contradictions.
map.列数 = 变量数 + 结果列；行数 = 2^变量数。可用其核对与/或/异或/蕴含: Number of columns = variable count + result column; number of rows = 2^variable count. It can be used to check the truth values of compound propositions such as AND/OR/XOR/implication.
map.如 A and B、A xor B、A -> B: e.g. A and B, A xor B, A -> B
